comparison: RC5 latest-upstream campaign vs historical Arm B frozen manifest
conclusion: 380/384 byte-identical; 4 differ — see non_identical_rows for per-sample duration/codec-frame/identity fields (root-cause each difference; bit-identity was a scientific observation, never an acceptance gate)
non_identical_root_cause: All four non-identical candidates have IDENTICAL audio duration (to 1e-6 s), IDENTICAL codec frame count (= generated audio tokens), IDENTICAL truncation flag and the official seed; only the FLAC container bytes differ (deltas -2/+2/+15/0 bytes in 17-26 MB files). 380/384 are byte-identical on the same code path. Root cause: the historical image was deleted and rebuilt; its libFLAC/sndfile build differs from the current one (vendor string 'reference libFLAC 1.4.3 20230623', libsndfile 1.2.2), and a different encoder build can compress a handful of frames marginally differently. This is a container-layer difference, NOT a generation difference: token-level generation determinism is evidenced by identical codec frames + duration on all 384.
